faq.q: When are property taxes due on a Vancouver home?
faq.a: To the City of Vancouver, twice a year: advance taxes were due February 3, 2026 and main taxes were due July 3, 2026, with a 5% penalty on unpaid balances after the main-tax deadline.

faq.q: What is the Empty Homes Tax declaration?
faq.a: Every Vancouver residential property owner must submit an annual property status declaration on or before the 2nd business day in February under Vacancy Tax By-law No. 11674; a vacancy tax that remains unpaid as of the 10th business day of April bears a 5% penalty.

faq.q: Which parts of Vancouver does this page cover?
faq.a: The whole City of Vancouver — the first page alone carries West End VW, Collingwood VE, Renfrew VE, Mount Pleasant VE, South Marine, South Granville, Kerrisdale, University VW and South Cambie listings; it does not cover North Vancouver, West Vancouver, Burnaby or Richmond, which have their own pages.
